name: Classic
summary: Terraform Mars with the familiar core deck.
scenario: Build your corporation, raise the global parameters, and compete to make Mars habitable.

rules.title: The race for Mars
rules.text: Standard terraforming, cities, greenery, milestones, awards, and scoring apply.

rules.title: Curated core deck
rules.text: Optional Preludes provide starting advantages. Venus and Colonies can be enabled separately or together, adding their cards and rules. Politics and Earth-withdrawal mechanics are not included.

features.name: Preludes
features.description: Choose starting preludes curated for this mode.

features.name: Venus
features.description: Add Venus terraforming, cards, corporations, and the Venus board.

features.name: Colonies
features.description: Add colony tiles, trading, cards, and corporations.

features.name: Project Funding
features.description: Experimental shared funding objectives. Balance testing is ongoing.

name: Earth Withdrawal
summary: Build with cheap Earth support before contact ends, then make your economy independent.
scenario: Use Earth support to grow, then build an economy that works without it. Normal terraforming and scoring still apply.

rules.title: While connected
rules.text: Once everyone is ready to take actions, gain M€ each connected generation: 2, then 3, 4, 5 and so on. A disconnected generation resets the amount to 2.

rules.title: When Earth withdraws
rules.text: Contact ends after the chosen generation’s production. Earth-dependent effects stop. Keep your cards, tags and resources.

rules.title: Make effects permanent
rules.text: Import a project’s Earth-dependent effects to keep them working after withdrawal. Its upkeep becomes permanent too.

rules.title: Restore contact
rules.text: Reconnection cards temporarily restore Earth support: for the next generation, or for production only.

rules.title: Earth support
rules.text: Everyone gains 2 M€ before the first actions of generation 1. Each consecutive connected generation increases this by 1 M€. Everyone receives this payment together after all players finish production and card selection. A disconnected generation resets the amount to 2. Production-only reconnections do not grant this payment. Effects marked with the connected Earth icon need contact. Earth tags alone do not.

rules.title: Withdrawal
rules.text: Choose withdrawal after generation 4, 6, or 8. The default is 6. Contact ends after that generation’s production. Withdrawal happens once: later reconnection does not reset before/after conditions or repeat withdrawal rewards.

rules.title: Changing the deadline
rules.text: Cards can move Earth's withdrawal 1 generation earlier or later, up to 2 generations from its starting date. Each player may change it once per generation. Moving it earlier must leave at least one full generation of notice. The deadline is fixed after withdrawal.

rules.title: What survives
rules.text: Keep your played cards, resources, tags, tiles, and victory points when contact ends. Effects marked with the connected Earth icon need contact. Earth tags alone do not. Only those groups stop. Their production and upkeep return together if contact is restored. Earth-supported production cannot pay permanent production reductions.

rules.title: Import technology
rules.text: Importing makes the Earth-dependent effects of one eligible owned project permanent, including upkeep and action costs. Initial gains do not repeat. Only marked eligible projects can be imported. The shared stipend, corporations, preludes, and lease payments cannot be imported. Copied production retains its own dependency: importing the original does not import the copy.

rules.title: Shut down Earth support
rules.text: Shutting down a project permanently disables its Earth-supported group, including upkeep, actions, and passive effects. Keep the played card, tags, victory points, stored resources, and independent effects. Imported or already shut-down groups cannot be targeted. Lease payments are a separate obligation and cannot be shut down.

rules.title: Lease payments
rules.text: Lease payments last until withdrawal, then end permanently. They are separate from Earth support, cannot be imported, and do not count as an Earth-supported project. Copied lease payments keep the same expiry.

rules.title: Temporary reconnection
rules.text: Reconnection cards restore Earth contact for the next generation, or only for this generation’s production. A production-only connection provides no action opportunity. Play these cards while disconnected. Windows cannot overlap. A connection for this production can coexist with one for the next generation. Contact closes again when its window ends.

rules.title: Deck and options
rules.text: The mode has its own curated projects and corporations. Preludes are optional. Venus and Colonies are not used.

parameters.label: Withdrawal after generation
parameters.description: Earth contact ends after this generation’s production, before later card adjustments.
